takeaway: The k8s manifests run two single-container pods: the prebuilt dsyer/petclinic image (profile postgres, NodePort 80 -> 8080) and postgres:18.4, sharing credentials through the demo-db Secret.

elements.name: Client machine
elements.responsibility: Reaches the app through the NodePort Service

elements.name: Kubernetes cluster (kind in CI)
elements.responsibility: Target of kubectl apply -f k8s/; kind cluster in the CI workflow

elements.name: petclinic Pod
elements.responsibility: Deployment petclinic, 1 replica, port 8080, SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=postgres, probes /livez and /readyz

elements.name: dsyer/petclinic (container image)
elements.responsibility: Prebuilt app image; not built from this repo's manifests

elements.name: Secret demo-db
elements.responsibility: Service-binding Secret (type servicebinding.io/postgresql): host, port, database, username, password
